requests.text: Initialize moldea for Cobalt Rooms, a local CLI that helps workshop coordinators find suitable rooms. Use fictional room and booking files, capacity and equipment checks, and a 15-minute turnaround between bookings. Coordinators approve bookings. Start with the project context and a small implementation proposal; hold application implementation for now.
requests.observedResult: Explicit initialization and proposal completed while app implementation stayed on hold; final validation zero diagnostics.

requests.text: That proposal works. Implement the read-only planner and availability report with the four small responsibilities you proposed, using plain JavaScript and the built-in Node test runner. Keep the exact 15-minute boundary in both directions, evaluate each request independently, reject malformed inputs clearly, and show the supplied example requests in the documentation. Coordinators still approve every booking and no input file should be written.
requests.observedResult: Implemented deterministic read-only four-module planner at15 minutes;65 actor tests passed and supplied CLI outcomes verified.

requests.text: What would a 30-minute turnaround change? Assess the impact, but do not change any files.
requests.observedResult: Read-only30-minute hypothetical compared actual in-memory outcomes with writes denied; no source change and approved policy remained15.

requests.text: Coordinator handoff: coordinators also check a printed equipment checklist before approving a room.
requests.observedResult: Informational handoff identified the printed-checklist fact missing from current context/README, without persisting it or changing code.

requests.text: Correction: the approved room turnaround is 30 minutes, not 15. Leave the booking code unchanged for now.
requests.observedResult: Unambiguous correction recorded approved30 versus implemented15 in existing project context and supporting docs/manifest; src/test/data unchanged. No assistance before this checkpoint.

requests.text: Apply the approved 30-minute turnaround to the planner now, including reports, relevant documentation and checks. Exactly 30 minutes should pass before or after a booking; shorter gaps should fail. Keep coordinators as approvers and input files read-only. Use the existing sample files to show the new outcomes.
requests.observedResult: Separately authorized implementation aligned planner/report/docs/context to30 minutes inclusive on either side;69 actor tests and final validation passed.

requests.text: Add a small standalone staff-roster formatter under tools, separate from the room planner. It should read a JSON array of fictional people with name and role from stdin and print a two-column Markdown table, preserving input order. Escape pipe characters and show embedded newlines without creating extra table rows. Validate the whole input before printing any output, with useful errors on stderr and a nonzero exit for invalid input. Include focused tests and a short tools/README.md with copyable examples. This is just roster formatting; no booking feature is involved.
requests.observedResult: Added standalone roster formatter,13 focused tests and copyable tools documentation.82 total actor tests passed; only three tools files changed and relevance printed0 with no subsequent moldea action.
